inputs.label: Your own decrypted dump of Soul Sacrifice Delta, US (PCSA00152) or EU (PCSF00532), with update 1.30: its folder, .zip or .vpk, or the PSN .pkg with its work.bin or .rif beside it.

Optional: the Japanese Voice-over Pack add-on for your version (US: UP9000-PCSA00152_00-SSS000CVN0000001, EU: EP9000-PCSF00532_00-SSS000CVN0000001): its decrypted folder or .zip, or its .pkg with its work.bin or .rif beside it. In the game: Options, Lang/Sub Settings, Voice Language.

Optional: a rePatch mod such as the Undub patch (the folder that holds its rePatch folder, or a .zip of it; extract a .7z first), or a packaged mod (.zip with ss-delta-mod.json, such as The Original Raiments). For the US or the EU game alike.

prepare.label: Building the game from your dump: the PS Vita firmware is downloaded from Sony, and the game's code is compiled on this computer

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Fullscreen or a window. F11 or Alt+Enter switches while playing.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The window's size in Windowed mode, as a multiple of the Vita's screen.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 960 x 544 is the Vita's screen; higher needs a faster graphics card.

settings.label: 3D resolution
settings.help: On a Vita the game draws its 3D at 720 x 408 and stretches it. Full draws it at the screen's resolution, like the menus.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: 60 is the default. 90 and 120 are for high-refresh displays. 30 is the Vita's rate.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Waits for the screen's refresh, so the picture never tears.

settings.label: Scaling filter
settings.help: How the picture is fitted to the window. FSR and CAS sharpen the picture. FXAA smooths edges. Nearest keeps pixels sharp.

settings.label: Smooth textures
settings.help: Stops the ground and walls shimmering in motion. Off looks as on the Vita.

settings.label: Language
settings.help: The US game has English, French, Spanish and Portuguese; the EU game English, French, Spanish, German and Italian. One the game lacks gives English.

settings.label: Add-ons
settings.help: The raiments, hoods and extra pacts. Their content is in update 1.30, and PSN, which sold them, is closed.

settings.label: Mods
settings.help: rePatch mods added in the setup, such as the Undub patch. Off plays the game as installed.

settings.label: Ad Hoc Play
settings.help: Local: copies of the game on this PC play together. Network: PCs, Steam Decks, Macs and Android devices on one network (or a VPN) play together.

settings.label: Log detail
settings.help: How much goes into ss-delta/vita3k.log. More helps with a bug report.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your saves: three slots and the add-on record.

actions.label: Screenshots
actions.help: F12 in the game saves one here.

actions.label: Log
actions.help: vita3k.log, for a bug report; vita3k.1.log to vita3k.4.log are the runs before it.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so later quests don't stutter. Clear it only if graphics look wrong after an update.
